files.code:
# party_up_manager.verse
# Summary: T-043 "PartyUp" - detects when a player is in a same-session party of size >= 2 via the official
#   Social Synergy API (Player.GetLocalParty()), grants each such player a party-size-scaled gold bonus
#   (BaseRewardAmount 5000 x 100/115/130/150%) once per player per session through a native Item Granter, and shows
#   status/reward/nudge messages via native HUD Message Devices plus a PartyNudge line on WB_Main.
# Last modified: 2026-11-05 — v15
#
# Notes (still valid):
#  - API: Player.GetLocalParty() returns agent_group_interface(party_member_info) (not a bare agent_group); modules used:
#    /UnrealEngine.com/Social, /Verse.org/AgentGroup, /Verse.org/Simulation; AddMemberEvent/RemoveMemberEvent are
#    listenable(tuple(agent, party_member_info)).
#  - Gold grant: own dedicated item_granter_device (GoldRefundGranter pattern from AreaUnlockManager), DefaultItemCount set
#    right before GrantItem(Agent); success confirmed via the device's ItemGrantedEvent (GrantItem returns void). Never
#    touches GameManager's gold ledger (independence boundary, T-042).
#  - Reward math is integer basis points (GetPartyBonusBasisPoints / GetScaledPartyReward; base Verse has no int<->float
#    conversion). Division is hand-rolled (DivideByOneHundred) because `/` yields rational and Quotient is <decides>, which
#    is rejected in Subscribe-callback call graphs (no_rollback diagnostics 3510-3512).
#  - UI: a Verse-bound WBP_PartyUp never reached the digest (empty class body, MCP VerseFieldsToolset gap, BUGS.md B-019),
#    so messages use native hud_message_device.Show(Agent, ...) shown only to the affected player. The WBP_PartyUp asset
#    is left unplaced. WBP_PartyUpExplainer is a static in-world widget (no Verse fields) placed outside the play area.
#    UMGToolSet.AddWidget cannot add UEFN_TextBlock directly; add an Image then ReplaceWidgetWithTemplate.
#  - WB_Main PartyNudge (message) is pushed via GameManagerRef.CoinDisplay.GetWidget(Player) after a short deferred Sleep in
#    OnPlayerAdded (coin_display_manager may not have built the widget yet) and on every party-size change; event-driven only.
#  - Multiplayer: up to 4 players, independent party state; RewardedThisSession is a plain session-scoped per-agent map (not
#    persistable) written only by that agent's own handlers, never reset on party join/leave (anti-exploit), pruned on
#    OnPlayerRemoved. Each player gets its own party_up_relay subscribing to its own GetLocalParty() group; the two
#    Subscribe() cancelables are stored in PartySubscriptions and cancelled on leave, with all per-agent maps pruned via
#    player_state_utils.WithRemovedKey. A rejoin starts fresh (once-per-session guards reset).
#  - Solo nudge: shown once per session after the player's first round completes while solo, via PartyUpRoundCompleteTrigger
#    (bind to the SAME physical Trigger as GameManager's RoundCompleteTrigger). Bonus reinforcement hooks
#    GameManagerRef.GoldAwardedEvent (GameManager has no public round-end event), once per session, only for party size >= 2.
#  - GetPartyBonus(Player) is a read-only basis-points getter over LastKnownPartySize (not wired into economy). PartyDailyQuestTrigger
#    fires per round completion for party >= 2: bind it to a daily_quests quest_config ProgressTrigger manually in the Details panel.
#  - RoundThresholds (default 5/10/15) fire at round completion, one-shot per
#    player/threshold/session. KPI triggers (NudgeShownAnalyticsTrigger, PartyFormedAfterNudgeAnalyticsTrigger) are only
#    native trigger_devices for an Analytics Device (T-031/T-036: never call Analytics from Verse).
#  - Shared triggers/GameManagerRef stay in place (not moved onto the demo_PartyUp stand); the stand holds the manager, item
#    granter and the 4 HUD message devices.
using { /Fortnite.com/Devices }
using { player_state_utils }
using { /Fortnite.com/Game }
using { /Fortnite.com/Characters }
using { /Fortnite.com/Playspaces }
using { /Verse.org/Simulation }
using { /UnrealEngine.com/Social }
using { /Verse.org/AgentGroup }
using { /UnrealEngine.com/Temporary/Diagnostics }

S2M<localizes>(Value : string) : message = "{Value}"

# Small relay object bound one-per-player, mirroring AreaUnlockManager.verse's area_unlock_relay
# pattern (T-081: the relay is stored in RelaysPerPlayer; the older claim that Subscribe holds only a weak reference is unproven - see GameManager v45): the AddMemberEvent/
# RemoveMemberEvent listenables are shared per party group, so each subscribing player needs its
# own relay capturing which player/agent it's evaluating for. Named local function declarations
# and function-literal lambdas are both unsupported inside a method body in this Verse version
# (confirmed via BuildAll diagnostics 3502/3547 during development), so this relay class is the
# mechanism for carrying per-player context into the event callback.
party_up_relay := class:
    Manager : party_up_manager
    RelayPlayer : player
    RelayAgent : agent
    OnMemberChanged(Change : tuple(agent, party_member_info)) : void=
        Manager.EvaluatePartyState(RelayPlayer, RelayAgent, RelayPlayer.GetLocalParty())

party_up_manager<public> := class(creative_device):

    # --- Logging (rule 2) ---
    @editable PartyUpDebugLoggingEnabled : logic = true
    PartyUpLog(LogMessage : string) : void=
        if (PartyUpDebugLoggingEnabled?):
            Print(LogMessage)

    # --- Configuration ---
    # Own dedicated Item Granter (same independence pattern as AreaUnlockManager's
    # GoldRefundGranter) - configure in UEFN with Key Item = GoldItemData, matching the same
    # physical gold item GameManager/AreaUnlockManager already use.
    @editable PartyGoldGranter : item_granter_device = item_granter_device{}

    # v3 (T-049): renamed from RewardAmount - this is now the BASE amount before the party-size
    # multiplier from GetPartyBonusBasisPoints/GetScaledPartyReward below is applied.
    @editable BaseRewardAmount : int = 5000

    # Native HUD Message Devices (place all four in UEFN, outside the play area, grouped on this
    # module's DemoDisplay stand) - same "Show(Agent, Message, ?DisplayTime)" API already
    # validated in AreaUnlockManager.verse for per-player-only HUD confirmations.
    @editable PartyStatusMessageDevice : hud_message_device = hud_message_device{}
    @editable PartyRewardMessageDevice : hud_message_device = hud_message_device{}

    # v3 (T-049, task 2a/2b): two new contextual "bring a friend" HUD messages, same
    # per-player-only Show() pattern as the two devices above.
    @editable SoloNudgeMessageDevice : hud_message_device = hud_message_device{}
    @editable PartyBonusReinforcementMessageDevice : hud_message_device = hud_message_device{}

    # v3 (T-049, task 2a): independent listener bound in UEFN to the SAME physical Trigger actor
    # already bound to GameManager's own RoundCompleteTrigger - mirrors LeaderboardManager.verse's
    # RoundStartTrigger listener pattern, no new GameManager Verse coupling.
    @editable PartyUpRoundCompleteTrigger : trigger_device = trigger_device{}

    # v3 (T-049, task 2b): read-only reference to GameManager's public GoldAwardedEvent, same
    # pattern as LeaderboardManager.verse's GameManagerRef (module path, no `using` needed - see
    # that file's own field for precedent).
    @editable GameManagerRef : GameManager.game_manager = GameManager.game_manager{}

    # --- v6 (T-050, sub-item 2): fires once per round-completion for every currently-tracked
    # player whose party is >= 2 at that moment - bind a new quest_config entry in
    # daily_quests_device's QuestPool to this SAME physical Trigger actor (see header). ---
    @editable PartyDailyQuestTrigger : trigger_device = trigger_device{}

    # --- v6 (T-050, sub-item 4): expandable round-completion thresholds, default 5/10/15. ---
    @editable RoundThresholds : []int = array{5, 10, 15}

    # --- v6 (T-050, sub-item 5): KPI/conversion-rate native trigger fields only (see header). ---
    @editable NudgeShownAnalyticsTrigger : trigger_device = trigger_device{}
    @editable PartyFormedAfterNudgeAnalyticsTrigger : trigger_device = trigger_device{}

    # T-107: PartyThresholdReachedEvent removed (no subscriber anywhere).

    # --- Per-session state (deliberately NOT persistable - session-only bonus, see header) ---
    var RewardedThisSession : [agent]logic = map{}
    var RelaysPerPlayer : [agent]party_up_relay = map{}
    var LastKnownPartySize : [agent]int = map{}

    # v3 (T-049): one-shot-per-session guards for the two new contextual messages, same shape as
    # RewardedThisSession - never reset on party join/leave (RemoveMemberEvent); reset only when the player leaves the server (OnPlayerRemoved prunes the maps, v8).
    var SoloNudgeShownThisSession : [agent]logic = map{}
    var PartyBonusReinforcedThisSession : [agent]logic = map{}

    # v6 (T-050, sub-item 4): per-player list of thresholds already fired this session.
    var ThresholdsReachedThisSession : [agent][]int = map{}

    # v6 (T-050, sub-item 5): one-shot-per-session guard for the conversion-KPI trigger.
    var PartyFormedAfterNudgeFiredThisSession : [agent]logic = map{}

    # v8 (T-072): the two party-event subscriptions per player, kept so OnPlayerRemoved can cancel.
    var PartySubscriptions : [agent][]cancelable = map{}

    OnBegin<override>()<suspends> : void=
        PartyUpLog("PartyUpManager: OnBegin - subscribing existing and future players")
        GetPlayspace().PlayerAddedEvent().Subscribe(OnPlayerAdded)
        GetPlayspace().PlayerRemovedEvent().Subscribe(OnPlayerRemoved)
        for (Player : GetPlayspace().GetPlayers()):
            OnPlayerAdded(Player)
        PartyUpRoundCompleteTrigger.TriggeredEvent.Subscribe(OnRoundCompleteTriggered)
        spawn:
            AwaitGoldAwardedLoop()

    # --- Player join: subscribe to this player's own party events, evaluate initial state ---
    OnPlayerAdded(Player : player) : void=
        if (Agent := agent[Player]):
            Party := Player.GetLocalParty()

            Relay := party_up_relay{Manager := Self, RelayPlayer := Player, RelayAgent := Agent}
            if (set RelaysPerPlayer[Agent] = Relay):
                AddSub := Party.AddMemberEvent.Subscribe(Relay.OnMemberChanged)
                RemoveSub := Party.RemoveMemberEvent.Subscribe(Relay.OnMemberChanged)
                if (set PartySubscriptions[Agent] = array{AddSub, RemoveSub}) {}

            # Evaluate current party state immediately - covers the case where the player joins
            # already in a qualifying party (no Add/Remove event fires for membership already in
            # place at subscribe time). Silent (no HUD message) on this very first check so a
            # solo player isn't greeted with an unsolicited "you're alone" popup on join - only
            # actual party-size CHANGES after this point show a HUD message (see
            # EvaluatePartyState below).
            MemberMap := Party.GetMemberMap()
            if (set LastKnownPartySize[Agent] = MemberMap.Length):
                if (MemberMap.Length >= 2):
                    TryGrantPartyReward(Agent, MemberMap.Length)
            # v7 (T-050, sub-item 3): deferred push to WB_Main - coin_display_manager's
            # BuildAndShow (called from GameManager's own OnPlayerAdded) may not have built this
            # player's widget yet the instant this handler runs, same race PrestigeManager's
            # PushInitialWidgetState already documents and works around with a short Sleep.
            spawn:
                PushInitialPartyNudge(Player)
        else:
            PartyUpLog("PartyUpManager: OnPlayerAdded - could not resolve agent for joining player")

    # --- v8 (T-072): player left - cancel this player's party subscriptions and prune all their
    # per-agent state so nothing keeps firing for / accumulating on a departed agent. ---
    OnPlayerRemoved(Player : player) : void=
        if (Agent := agent[Player]):
            if (Subs := PartySubscriptions[Agent]):
                for (Sub : Subs):
                    Sub.Cancel()
            if (M := PartySubscriptions.WithRemovedKey(Agent)?):
                set PartySubscriptions = M
            if (M := RewardedThisSession.WithRemovedKey(Agent)?):
                set RewardedThisSession = M
            if (M := RelaysPerPlayer.WithRemovedKey(Agent)?):
                set RelaysPerPlayer = M
            if (M := LastKnownPartySize.WithRemovedKey(Agent)?):
                set LastKnownPartySize = M
            if (M := SoloNudgeShownThisSession.WithRemovedKey(Agent)?):
                set SoloNudgeShownThisSession = M
            if (M := PartyBonusReinforcedThisSession.WithRemovedKey(Agent)?):
                set PartyBonusReinforcedThisSession = M
            if (M := ThresholdsReachedThisSession.WithRemovedKey(Agent)?):
                set ThresholdsReachedThisSession = M
            if (M := PartyFormedAfterNudgeFiredThisSession.WithRemovedKey(Agent)?):
                set PartyFormedAfterNudgeFiredThisSession = M
            PartyUpLog("PartyUpManager: player left - cancelled party subscriptions and pruned per-agent state")
        else:
            PartyUpLog("PartyUpManager: OnPlayerRemoved - could not resolve agent for leaving player")

    # --- Core detection + reward logic (called on every Add/RemoveMemberEvent) ---
    EvaluatePartyState(Player : player, Agent : agent, Party : agent_group_interface(party_member_info)) : void=
        MemberMap := Party.GetMemberMap()
        PartySize := MemberMap.Length

        var PreviousSize : int = -1
        if (Prev := LastKnownPartySize[Agent]):
            set PreviousSize = Prev
        if (set LastKnownPartySize[Agent] = PartySize):
            PartyUpLog("PartyUpManager: tracked party size {PartySize} for a player")

        if (PartySize <> PreviousSize):
            if (PartySize >= 2):
                PartyStatusMessageDevice.Show(Agent, S2M("You're in a party with {PartySize - 1} friend(s)!"), ?DisplayTime := -1.0)
                TryGrantPartyReward(Agent, PartySize)
                # v6 (T-050, sub-item 5): conversion KPI - fires once, only for a player who had
                # already seen the solo nudge (T-049) and is now forming/joining a qualifying party.
                if (SoloNudgeShownThisSession[Agent]?, not PartyFormedAfterNudgeFiredThisSession[Agent]?):
                    if (set PartyFormedAfterNudgeFiredThisSession[Agent] = true):
                        PartyFormedAfterNudgeAnalyticsTrigger.Trigger(Agent)
            else:
                PartyStatusMessageDevice.Show(Agent, S2M("You're alone - invite a friend to your party!"), ?DisplayTime := -1.0)
            # v7 (T-050, sub-item 3): event-driven WB_Main nudge refresh, only on an actual size
            # change - no Tick/polling, same discipline as the superseded v6 board.
            RefreshPartyNudge(Player, PartySize)

    # --- Party reward scaling (task 1) - pure integer functions, tunable without touching call
    # sites. Integer basis-points math (not float) since every baseline value in the brief's table
    # is an exact integer multiple of BaseRewardAmount at this scale - see header note. ---
    GetPartyBonusBasisPoints(PartySize : int) : int=
        if (PartySize >= 4):
            150
        else if (PartySize = 3):
            130
        else if (PartySize = 2):
            115
        else:
            100

    GetScaledPartyReward(PartySize : int) : int=
        BasisPoints := GetPartyBonusBasisPoints(PartySize)
        DivideByOneHundred(BaseRewardAmount * BasisPoints)

    # Hand-rolled floor-division-by-100, deliberately NOT using Verse's `/` operator (types as
    # `rational` for int/int with no exposed int<-rational cast) nor the built-in `Quotient`
    # function (has the <decides> effect, which this whole call graph can't carry - TryGrantParty
    # Reward is reached from Subscribe callbacks (PlayerAddedEvent, AddMemberEvent/RemoveMemberEvent
    # via party_up_relay), and BuildAll confirmed - diagnostic 3512, persisting even before any
    # mutation in the caller - that a decides call is rejected as a 'no_rollback effect not allowed'
    # anywhere in that chain). Only +/-/comparisons, always terminates for a non-negative Numerator
    # (bounded by Numerator/100 iterations - about 7,500 for the default 5000 x 150%, scaling with BaseRewardAmount; a
    # one-off per grant, not a per-tick cost) and never fails, so no decides effect is needed at all.
    DivideByOneHundred(Numerator : int) : int=
        var RunningQuotient : int = 0
        var Remaining : int = Numerator
        loop:
            if (Remaining < 100):
                break
            set Remaining -= 100
            set RunningQuotient += 1
        RunningQuotient

    # --- One-time-per-session gold grant (v3: scaled by party size, task 1) ---
    TryGrantPartyReward(Agent : agent, PartySize : int) : void=
        if (not RewardedThisSession[Agent]?):
            if (set RewardedThisSession[Agent] = true):
                ScaledReward := GetScaledPartyReward(PartySize)
                PartyUpLog("PartyUpManager: player reached party size {PartySize} for the first time this session - granting {ScaledReward} gold (base {BaseRewardAmount})")
                set PartyGoldGranter.DefaultItemCount = ScaledReward
                PartyGoldGranter.GrantItem(Agent)
                PartyRewardMessageDevice.Show(Agent, S2M("Party bonus! +{ScaledReward} gold"), ?DisplayTime := -1.0)
                spawn:
                    VerifyPartyGoldGrant(Agent, ScaledReward)

    # --- Grant confirmation (same ItemGrantedEvent-race pattern as AreaUnlockManager v18) ---
    VerifyPartyGoldGrant(Agent : agent, ScaledReward : int)<suspends> : void=
        race:
            block:
                loop:
                    GrantedAgent := PartyGoldGranter.ItemGrantedEvent.Await()
                    if (GrantedAgent = Agent):
                        PartyUpLog("PartyUpManager: {ScaledReward} gold party bonus confirmed via ItemGrantedEvent")
                        break
            block:
                Sleep(2.0)
                PartyUpLog("PartyUpManager: CRITICAL - party bonus grant could NOT be confirmed within timeout (ItemGrantedEvent never fired) - GrantItem may have silently failed, e.g. inventory/key-item cap")

    # --- Task 2a: solo nudge, shown once per session per player, after THAT round completes if
    # the player is still solo at that point. PartyUpRoundCompleteTrigger is an independent
    # listener bound to the same physical Trigger actor as GameManager's own RoundCompleteTrigger
    # (see header) - its payload is `?agent` per the established project pattern
    # (LeaderboardManager.verse's OnKillTriggered), but the trigger itself fires once per round
    # completion regardless of which single agent is carried in the payload, so this handler
    # evaluates EVERY currently-tracked player rather than only the payload agent. ---
    OnRoundCompleteTriggered(_MaybeAgent : ?agent) : void=
        PartyUpLog("PartyUpManager: round complete signal received - evaluating solo nudge/quest-hook/thresholds for tracked players")
        CurrentRound := GameManagerRef.GetCurrentRound()
        for (Agent -> PartySize : LastKnownPartySize):
            if (PartySize < 2, not SoloNudgeShownThisSession[Agent]?):
                if (set SoloNudgeShownThisSession[Agent] = true):
                    SoloNudgeMessageDevice.Show(Agent, S2M("Playing solo? Invite a friend to your party for bonus rewards!"), ?DisplayTime := -1.0)
                    NudgeShownAnalyticsTrigger.Trigger(Agent)
            if (PartySize >= 2):
                # v6 (T-050, sub-item 2): fires the Daily Quest hook's trigger each qualifying
                # round completion - see header for the daily_quests_device.verse extension point.
                PartyDailyQuestTrigger.Trigger(Agent)
                # v6 (T-050, sub-item 4): round-threshold events.
                EvaluateRoundThresholds(Agent, PartySize, CurrentRound)

    # --- Task 2b: party bonus reinforcement, hooked to GameManager's public GoldAwardedEvent (see
    # header for why this event was chosen over the alternatives). Shown once per session, only to
    # players currently in a qualifying party. ---
    AwaitGoldAwardedLoop()<suspends> : void=
        loop:
            # T-102: event = wake-up, queue = source of truth (see GameManager.TakePartyGold).
            race:
                block:
                    GameManagerRef.GoldAwardedEvent.Await()
                block:
                    Sleep(1.0)
            Awards := GameManagerRef.TakePartyGold()
            for (Payload : Awards):
                OnGoldAwarded(Payload)

    # T-091 instrumentation: handled counter vs GameManager's GoldSignalsSent.
    var GoldHandledCount : int = 0

    OnGoldAwarded(Payload : tuple(agent, int)) : void=
        Agent := Payload(0)
        set GoldHandledCount += 1
        if (PartyUpDebugLoggingEnabled?):
            PartyUpLog("PartyUpManager[SIGNAL-DIAG]: gold handled #{GoldHandledCount} / sent #{GameManagerRef.GoldSignalsSent}")
        if (PartySize := LastKnownPartySize[Agent]):
            if (PartySize >= 2, not PartyBonusReinforcedThisSession[Agent]?):
                if (set PartyBonusReinforcedThisSession[Agent] = true):
                    PartyUpLog("PartyUpManager: reinforcing party bonus for a player currently in a party of {PartySize}")
                    PartyBonusReinforcementMessageDevice.Show(Agent, S2M("Squad up! Your party is earning bonus rewards right now."), ?DisplayTime := -1.0)

    # --- v6 (T-050, sub-item 1): public read-only bonus getter - see header for why this can never
    # diverge from what TryGrantPartyReward actually applies (same state, same basis-points func).
    # Returns basis points: 100 = no bonus, 115/130/150 for party size 2/3/4. NOT wired into any
    # economy_ledger/shop flow in this task - deferred explicitly to a future consumer. ---
    GetPartyBonus(Player : player) : int=
        if (Agent := agent[Player]):
            if (PartySize := LastKnownPartySize[Agent]):
                return GetPartyBonusBasisPoints(PartySize)
        GetPartyBonusBasisPoints(1)

    # --- v6 (T-050, sub-item 4): round-threshold evaluation helpers. ---
    # Inlined (not split into a separate ThresholdAlreadyReached helper) - a helper function
    # returning `logic` from this pattern was rejected by BuildAll with a "no_rollback effect not
    # allowed" error when called from EvaluateRoundThresholds' `if`, the same class of restriction
    # already documented above DivideByOneHundred for this file's Subscribe-driven call chain.
    # Inlining keeps the map-lookup decides effect local to this one function, same shape as
    # EvaluatePartyState's existing `if (Prev := LastKnownPartySize[Agent])` pattern.
    EvaluateRoundThresholds(Agent : agent, PartySize : int, CurrentRound : int) : void=
        for (Threshold : RoundThresholds):
            if (CurrentRound >= Threshold):
                var AlreadyReached : logic = false
                if (ReachedList := ThresholdsReachedThisSession[Agent]):
                    for (Reached : ReachedList):
                        if (Reached = Threshold):
                            set AlreadyReached = true
                if (AlreadyReached = false):
                    MarkThresholdReached(Agent, Threshold)
                    PartyUpLog("PartyUpManager: party round-threshold {Threshold} reached for a player (round {CurrentRound}, party size {PartySize})")

    MarkThresholdReached(Agent : agent, Threshold : int) : void=
        var UpdatedList : []int = array{}
        if (ExistingList := ThresholdsReachedThisSession[Agent]):
            set UpdatedList = ExistingList
        set UpdatedList += array{Threshold}
        if (set ThresholdsReachedThisSession[Agent] = UpdatedList) {}

    # --- v7 (T-050, sub-item 3): per-player WB_Main nudge push - see header for why this replaces
    # the superseded shared-3D-board design. Reads through GameManagerRef.CoinDisplay.GetWidget
    # (the SAME read-only accessor PrestigeManager.verse already uses), so this module still never
    # calls into GameManager/coin_display_manager beyond that one getter, and never builds/owns a
    # widget itself. ---
    # T-107: waits for GameManager's HUD-ready event (with its own timeout fallback) instead of Sleep(1.0).
    PushInitialPartyNudge(Player : player)<suspends> : void=
        GameManagerRef.WaitForHud(Player)
        CurrentPartySize := if (Agent := agent[Player], PartySize := LastKnownPartySize[Agent]) then PartySize else 1
        RefreshPartyNudge(Player, CurrentPartySize)

    RefreshPartyNudge(Player : player, PartySize : int) : void=
        if (Widget := GameManagerRef.CoinDisplay.GetWidget[Player]):
            set Widget.PartyNudge = GetPartyNudgeMessage(PartySize)

    # Single combined message: current size + whether the bonus is active + (below the max tier) a
    # motivational nudge naming the next reachable bonus - the exact "hey, did you know inviting
    # friends earns you XYZ?" push/nudge the owner asked for, reusing GetPartyBonusBasisPoints so
    # the displayed % can never diverge from what TryGrantPartyReward actually grants.
    GetPartyNudgeMessage(PartySize : int) : message=
        if (PartySize <= 1):
            NextBonus := GetPartyBonusBasisPoints(2) - 100
            S2M("Playing solo. Invite a friend to your party for +{NextBonus}% bonus rewards!")
        else:
            CurrentBonus := GetPartyBonusBasisPoints(PartySize) - 100
            if (PartySize < 4):
                NextBonus := GetPartyBonusBasisPoints(PartySize + 1) - 100
                S2M("Party bonus ACTIVE: +{CurrentBonus}%! Invite one more for +{NextBonus}%.")
            else:
                S2M("Party bonus ACTIVE: +{CurrentBonus}% (max tier reached!)")

files.name: Playtime_manager.verse
files.code:
# Playtime_manager.verse
# Summary: Playtime reward device (formerly Xp_manager/xp_timer_manager) with two independent responsibilities: (1) LEGACY per-tier trigger loop - every
#   IntervalSeconds each configured RewardTiers entry fires Tier.Trigger.Trigger(Player) for every online player (downstream Accolades_xp_1..6 keep working);
#   (2) continuous playtime checkpoint loop (T-025) driving the per-player WBP_Playtime WebUI widget (gated by EnableWebUI).
# Last modified: 2026-10-01 — v11 (T-095, comment-only)
#
#
# Notes (still valid):
#  - Continuous timeline: per-player playtime accumulates and never resets. RewardTiers' IntervalSeconds (5,10,15,30,45,60 min) are ordered checkpoints on it; after
#    the last one the same ordered list repeats on top of the accumulated time (checkpoint N+1 after wrap = CycleLengthSeconds + RewardTiers[0].IntervalSeconds). It is
#    a repeating ruler over one counter, not a round. The v2 per-tier trigger loop is untouched so Trigger_playtime_1..6 -> Accolades_xp_1..6 wiring keeps working.
#  - WBP_Playtime fields (authored on the widget BP, confirmed via VerseFieldsToolset): Progress, SuccAnim, IsSucc, and `timer` (message; the field name is lowercase
#    "timer"). The timer writes an MM:SS countdown to the NEXT checkpoint of the continuous tracker (not the legacy loop, not Daily Reward): NextThreshold -
#    PositionInCycle every tick, so it resets to the real segment length (segments can differ, e.g. 5->10 is 5 min, 15->30 is 15 min). Formatting reuses the
#    string->message <localizes> + ZeroPad2 (shared_utils) pattern from TimedEventsManager.
#  - Elapsed is the real clock (GetSecondsSinceEpoch() - StartTime), not `+= 1.0` per Sleep(1.0), which drifted slow under load (T-085b). The "VERIFY first"
#    measurement was never run (no live session).
#  - Per-player liveness: ActivePlayers tracks it; TrackPlayerPlaytime stops when its key is missing; OnPlayerRemoved removes the ActivePlayers and PlayerWidgets entries
#    (WithRemovedKey) and collapses the widget (T-073).
#  - OPEN ITEM (2026-09-08): WBP_Playtime_entity (world/3D version of the same fields) has no placed asset/instance and no update code exists; once the owner creates
#    it in UEFN, add an UpdateWorldEntities pass mirroring UpdateWidgets - until then nothing to update, not a bug.
#
using { /Fortnite.com/Devices }
using { /Verse.org/Simulation }
using { /Verse.org/SceneGraph }
using { /UnrealEngine.com/Temporary/Diagnostics }
using { /UnrealEngine.com/Temporary/UI }
using { /Fortnite.com/Playspaces }
using { player_state_utils }
using { shared_utils }

# T-067: string->message conversion for the new `timer` Verse field on WBP_Playtime, same
# <localizes> pattern already used project-wide (e.g. TimedEventsManager.verse's S2M_TimedEvents).
S2M_Playtime<localizes>(Value : string) : message = "{Value}"

xp_reward_tier := class<concrete>:
    @editable Trigger : trigger_device = trigger_device{}
    @editable IntervalSeconds : float = 60.0

Playtime_manager := class(creative_device):

    # Legacy per-tier trigger config (v2) — also doubles as the ordered checkpoint list for the
    # new continuous progress tracker (v3). Currently configured in UEFN as 5,10,15,30,45,60 min.
    @editable_container:
        AllowReordering := true
    @editable RewardTiers : []xp_reward_tier = array{}

    # T-025: master switch for the WebUI (2D/HUD) widget version. Turn off to disable the per-player widget
    # (the World entity version is not implemented yet).
    @editable EnableWebUI : logic = true

    # How long the success animation stays "on" (SuccAnim = 1.0 / IsSucc = true) after a
    # checkpoint is reached, before resetting back to 0/false. Per owner spec: 30 seconds.
    @editable SuccessAnimSeconds : float = 30.0

    # Logger centralizzato: stesso pattern degli altri device del progetto.
    @editable DebugLoggingEnabled : logic = true

    Log(LogMessage : string):void=
        if (DebugLoggingEnabled?):
            Print(LogMessage)

    # Per-player WebUI widget instances, so each player's HUD reflects only their own progress
    # (multiplayer: playtime/progress is per-player state, never shared/broadcast).
    var PlayerWidgets : [player]WBP_Playtime = map{}

    # Tracks which players currently have a live TrackPlayerPlaytime coroutine, so that coroutine
    # can check it and stop itself cleanly on disconnect instead of running forever against a
    # player that's already gone (Verse doesn't auto-cancel a spawned coroutine just because the
    # `player` it captured left the playspace).
    var ActivePlayers : [player]logic = map{}

    OnBegin<override>()<suspends>:void=
        # Legacy per-tier trigger loop — unchanged behavior, still feeds the existing
        # Trigger_playtime_1..6 -> Accolades_xp_1..6 chain the owner already wired in UEFN.
        Sleep(1.0)
        for (Index -> Tier : RewardTiers):
            spawn{ StartRewardLoop(Index, Tier) }

        # New continuous per-player checkpoint/progress loop (T-025).
        Playspace := GetPlayspace()
        Playspace.PlayerAddedEvent().Subscribe(OnPlayerAdded)
        Playspace.PlayerRemovedEvent().Subscribe(OnPlayerRemoved)
        for (Player : Playspace.GetPlayers()):
            OnPlayerAdded(Player)

    # Legacy loop (v2, untouched) — fires a trigger for every online player on each tier's own
    # fixed interval, independent of the new continuous tracker below.
    StartRewardLoop(Index : int, Tier : xp_reward_tier)<suspends>:void=
        loop:
            Sleep(Tier.IntervalSeconds)

            Players := GetPlayspace().GetPlayers()
            for (Player : Players):
                # Premio XP standard — trigger_device al posto
                # dell'accolade device, cosi' si puo' agganciare un
                # Analytics Device a valle in editor.
                Tier.Trigger.Trigger(Player)

            Log("XP & Economy Tick: Tier {Index} ({Tier.IntervalSeconds}s) -> {Players.Length} player premiati")

    # New (T-025): one player joined — spin up their WebUI widget (if enabled) and their
    # independent continuous playtime/checkpoint coroutine.
    OnPlayerAdded(Agent : agent):void=
        if (Player := player[Agent]):
            if (set ActivePlayers[Player] = true):
                if (EnableWebUI?):
                    spawn{ SetupWebUIWidget(Player) }
                spawn{ TrackPlayerPlaytime(Player) }

    # New (T-025): player disconnected — stop their tracker coroutine (checked at the top of
    # TrackPlayerPlaytime's loop below) and drop their WebUI widget entry so it isn't updated
    # or leaked after they're gone.
    OnPlayerRemoved(Player : player):void=
        if (set ActivePlayers[Player] = false):
            Log("PlaytimeReward: player left, stopping their playtime tracker")
        if (Widget := PlayerWidgets[Player]):
            Widget.SetVisibility(widget_visibility.Collapsed)
        # T-073: prune both per-player maps (the tracker loop treats a missing key as "left").
        if (NewActive := ActivePlayers.WithRemovedKey(Player)?):
            set ActivePlayers = NewActive
        if (NewWidgets := PlayerWidgets.WithRemovedKey(Player)?):
            set PlayerWidgets = NewWidgets

    SetupWebUIWidget(Player : player)<suspends>:void=
        if (PlayerUI := GetPlayerUI[Player]):
            NewWidget : WBP_Playtime = WBP_Playtime{}
            PlayerUI.AddWidget(NewWidget)
            if (set PlayerWidgets[Player] = NewWidget):
                Log("PlaytimeReward: WebUI widget attached for a player")
        else:
            Log("PlaytimeReward: [WARN] GetPlayerUI failed, WebUI widget not attached")

    # Ordered checkpoint list, in seconds, taken from RewardTiers (already 5,10,15,30,45,60 min
    # in UEFN). Sorted defensively in case the editable array isn't authored in ascending order.
    GetSortedCheckpointsSeconds() : []float=
        var Checkpoints : []float = array{}
        for (Tier : RewardTiers):
            set Checkpoints += array{Tier.IntervalSeconds}
        # Simple ascending insertion sort — the array is tiny (a handful of tiers), so this is
        # cheap and avoids pulling in a bigger sort utility for six elements.
        var Sorted : []float = array{}
        for (Value : Checkpoints):
            var Inserted : logic = false
            var Result : []float = array{}
            for (Existing : Sorted):
                if (not Inserted? and Value < Existing):
                    set Result += array{Value}
                    set Inserted = true
                set Result += array{Existing}
            if (not Inserted?):
                set Result += array{Value}
            set Sorted = Result
        return Sorted

    # New (T-025): continuous per-player playtime tracker. Never resets — Elapsed only grows for
    # as long as the player is on this island. Checkpoints repeat cyclically over that one
    # continuous counter (see file header).
    TrackPlayerPlaytime(Player : player)<suspends>:void=
        Checkpoints := GetSortedCheckpointsSeconds()
        if (Checkpoints.Length = 0):
            Log("PlaytimeReward: RewardTiers is empty, nothing to track for this player")
            return

        if (LastCheckpoint := Checkpoints[Checkpoints.Length - 1]):
            CycleLength := LastCheckpoint
            var Elapsed : float = 0.0
            var NextCheckpointIndex : int = 0
            # T-085c: last CycleCount seen by this coroutine, to detect the cycle wrap.
            var LastCycleCount : int = 0
            # T-085b: Elapsed is measured against the real clock instead of `+= 1.0` per iteration -
            # each `Sleep(1.0)` lasts at least 1s (longer under server load), so the old counter
            # drifted slow and the checkpoint (e.g. the 60 min one) fired late.
            StartTime : float = GetSecondsSinceEpoch()

            loop:
                Sleep(1.0)

                # Stop tracking once the player has disconnected (see OnPlayerRemoved) instead of
                # running this coroutine forever against a player who already left.
                # v6 (T-073): a missing key now also means "left" (ActivePlayers is pruned on leave).
                IsActive : logic = if (Active := ActivePlayers[Player]) then Active else false
                if (not IsActive?):
                    break

                set Elapsed = GetSecondsSinceEpoch() - StartTime

                if (CycleCount := Floor[Elapsed / CycleLength]):
                    PositionInCycle := Elapsed - (CycleCount * CycleLength)

                    var Advanced : logic = false
                    # Index (1-based) of the checkpoint reached this tick, for the log only.
                    var ReachedCheckpoint : int = 0

                    # T-085c (B-043): PositionInCycle is always < CycleLength (= last checkpoint), so
                    # the last checkpoint can never be crossed by the loop below. When CycleCount
                    # rises, the cycle just wrapped: count that as the last checkpoint firing and
                    # restart the checkpoint index.
                    if (CycleCount > LastCycleCount):
                        set LastCycleCount = CycleCount
                        set Advanced = true
                        set ReachedCheckpoint = Checkpoints.Length
                        set NextCheckpointIndex = 0

                    # Advance NextCheckpointIndex over every checkpoint boundary just crossed
                    # (usually just one per tick, but stays correct after a long hitch/hang).
                    loop:
                        if (NextCheckpointIndex < Checkpoints.Length, Threshold := Checkpoints[NextCheckpointIndex], PositionInCycle >= Threshold):
                            set NextCheckpointIndex += 1
                            set ReachedCheckpoint = NextCheckpointIndex
                            set Advanced = true
                        else:
                            break

                    if (NextCheckpointIndex >= Checkpoints.Length):
                        set NextCheckpointIndex = 0

                    # Progress toward the next checkpoint, normalized 0.0-1.0 within the segment.
                    PrevThreshold := if (NextCheckpointIndex = 0) then 0.0 else if (Prev := Checkpoints[NextCheckpointIndex - 1]) then Prev else 0.0
                    if (NextThreshold := Checkpoints[NextCheckpointIndex]):
                        SegmentLength := NextThreshold - PrevThreshold
                        Progress := if (SegmentLength > 0.0) then Clamp((PositionInCycle - PrevThreshold) / SegmentLength, 0.0, 1.0) else 0.0

                        # T-067: seconds remaining until NextCheckpointIndex fires, i.e. the real
                        # gap for this segment (NextThreshold - PrevThreshold) minus how far into
                        # it we already are — NOT the absolute session time. Clamped at 0 so a
                        # borderline tick never displays a negative value.
                        RawRemaining := NextThreshold - PositionInCycle
                        RemainingSecondsToNext := if (RawRemaining > 0.0) then RawRemaining else 0.0

                        UpdateWidgets(Player, Progress, bJustReached := Advanced, RemainingSeconds := RemainingSecondsToNext)

                        if (Advanced?):
                            Log("PlaytimeReward: player reached checkpoint {ReachedCheckpoint} of {Checkpoints.Length} (elapsed {Elapsed}s)")
                            spawn{ PlaySuccessAnim(Player) }

    # Pushes Progress and the MM:SS `timer` countdown (always) and SuccAnim/IsSucc (only right when a checkpoint is newly reached
    # — the reset back to 0/false happens 30s later in PlaySuccessAnim) to the WebUI widget.
    # OPEN ITEM (see file header): WBP_Playtime_entity (the World/3D version) has no placed
    # asset/instance in the project yet, so it can't be referenced from Verse at all right now —
    # there is no type to compile against. Once the owner creates that entity asset in UEFN (with
    # the same SuccAnim/IsSucc/Progress Verse fields as WBP_Playtime), add an
    # UpdateWorldEntities/PlaySuccessAnim-on-entity pass mirroring the widget one below.
    UpdateWidgets(Player : player, Progress : float, bJustReached : logic, RemainingSeconds : float):void=
        if (Widget := PlayerWidgets[Player]):
            set Widget.Progress = Progress
            set Widget.timer = S2M_Playtime(FormatMMSS(RemainingSeconds))
            if (bJustReached?):
                set Widget.SuccAnim = 1.0
                set Widget.IsSucc = true

    # T-067: MM:SS formatter for the `timer` field — same Floor[]/float-divisor + ZeroPad2
    # pattern already used by TimedEventsManager.verse's WriteCountdownToWidget (int division in
    # Verse yields a rational, always needs Floor[] against a float divisor).
    FormatMMSS(TotalSecondsF : float) : string=
        if (TotalSeconds := Floor[TotalSecondsF], Minutes := Floor[TotalSecondsF / 60.0], Seconds := Mod[TotalSeconds, 60]):
            "{ZeroPad2(Minutes)}:{ZeroPad2(Seconds)}"
        else:
            "00:00"

    # 30 seconds after a checkpoint is reached, reset the success flags back off.
    PlaySuccessAnim(Player : player)<suspends>:void=
        Sleep(SuccessAnimSeconds)
        if (Widget := PlayerWidgets[Player]):
            set Widget.SuccAnim = 0.0
            set Widget.IsSucc = false
